gingerbread hand cream

96% ingredients of natural origin

Enjoy the festive skincare with the enveloping scent of gingerbread. Perfect for cold days and winter evenings.

Brings relief to dry hands. Moisturises, softens and smooths the epidermis. Leaves an aromatic scent on the skin.

How to use

Massage the cream into the skin of hands and leave to absorb. Use as often as needed.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Octyldodecanol, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Cetyl Palmitate, Glycerin, Polyacrylamide, C13-14 Isoalkane, Laureth-7, Disodium EDTA, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Parfum (Fragrance), Benzyl Benzoate, Cinnamal, Eugenol, Vanillin, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Coumarin, Limonene.

The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2024-08.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

vegetable glycerin, cetyl palmitate
